anchors.adc_selected_profile: Sections2.4.1/2.4.2 p11: selected12bitLSB avoids6bitMSB failure and matches correctedLSB12bit layout. Section2.4.3 pp11-12: APB2/8 polling waits two1us monotonic ticks after observedEOC before SDK RDATAread; deadline/frozenclock failures publish no sample. AutonomousDMA instead selects/readback-proves HCLK/6 before calibration:100/3MHz>APB2/4=25MHz and belowDS40MHz, excluding the erratum clock condition without assuming DMA latency. anchors.timer_selected_profile: Section2.7.1 p13: shadow update only becomes effective on a rising counter edge; no workaround, so no arbitrary immediate PWM edge-update guarantee. Section2.7.2 singlepulse+APB=AHB/4+TIMER=AHB/2 is excluded by maintained repeating timer profiles; do not infer a one-pulse mode.
anchors.can_selected_profile: Sections2.13.1/2.13.2 pp17-18: FIFO-order abort may abort a second mailbox; with identifier ordering, extendedID0x1FFFFFFF requires mailbox0. The selected GD wrapper and shared controller must retain these separate restrictions; no implicit retransmission or STM32 qualification is inferred.
anchors.ethernet_selected_profile: Sections2.14.1/2.14.2 p18: maintained RMII excludes MII fault; raw and enhanced engines clear MAC IPFCO bit10 during readback-checked initialization and never enable it during link changes, retaining software checksums instead of dropping headerchecksum0x0000 in hardware. Section2.14.3 p19 has no workaround for the MAC's long interframe gap; link rate is not proven wire throughput or IEEE timing compliance.
anchors.gpio_supply: Sections2.3.1/2.3.2 p10: revisionA IOcompensation is ineffective; disabledVBUS PA9/PB13 are not5V tolerant. Package revision, external voltages and compensation-dependent edge budgets remain physical qualification inputs.
anchors.i2c_selected_profile: Section2.9.1 p14 permits I2C_FCTL on GD32F470 only, not F425/F427; this exactZGT6 provider never authorizes the adjacent families by similar registers.
anchors.excluded_modes: Sections2.1 standby;2.2 LXTALfailure;2.5 DAC;2.6 RTCcalibration;2.8 USARTmute;2.10 I2S;2.11 SDIO;2.12 EXMC are outside maintained selected profiles; shallowfixedrun sleep is not standby or deepstop.
